customManagers.description: Non-docker upstreams pinned as `# renovate:` comment + ARG VERSION in a Dockerfile (e.g. npm packages repackaged into an image).
Upstreams built from source at a pinned commit: `# renovate: datasource=git-refs depName=<repo url> currentValue=<branch>` + ARG COMMIT=<sha>. Renovate moves the sha when the branch head moves.

packageRules.description: These images exist only to repackage upstream releases; a base bump is the whole point of the repo, so let majors through too.
Same reasoning for upstreams built from a pinned commit: following the branch head is how these images stay current.
